P1.quote: The project rules say nothing gets coded, installed or locked in until you've approved the plan.

P2.quote: Where does membership money go? Does each gym get paid directly into its own account, with you taking a fee or charging a subscription? Or do you collect everything and pay the gyms out? This decides the payment setup and your legal and tax exposure.

P3.quote: This assumes: one shared app, each gym paid directly, trainer- or check-in-based attendance, one country at launch.

P4.quote: | Website to sell to gyms | Later | Useful once you're actively selling to gyms. |

P5.quote: Several gyms on one system. Each gym's data must be kept strictly separate from the others. This is the most important rule in the whole design.

P6.quote: | Payments | Stripe for subscriptions, plus Stripe Connect (each gym gets its own account) | Building our own: far more risk and compliance work. Card details never touch our servers. |

P7.quote: I finalise which parts to build and the technology, with verified versions. 4. **You approve.** Only then do I move on to design and the build plan.
